test_title: PYST 26: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

Everyone have/ to join health orientation/ classes before/ going for trekking.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the first part of the given sentence, the plural form of the verb 'have' is incorrect.
 
• In the given sentence, the subject **'Everyone'** is **singular**.
 
• The verb should agree with the singular subject, thus the **singular form of the verb** should be used.
 
 
• **Example:** ***Everyone has** the right to speak*.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the singular form of the verb 'has' should be used in place of the plural form 'have'.

 

Hence, the correct statement is: ***Everyone has__ to join health orientation classes before going for trekking*.**
